name: Kamikoani (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kamikoani village emblem in white: a ring open at the top with a small disc, enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikoani, a village in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 August 1960.

features.role: Kamikoani village emblem — a ring open at the top with a small disc, enclosing a stylised letter M
